fts 0.13.0 - seven commands for a project consuming the FTS platform packages.

  fts feed init [--feed <url|folder>] [--no-token] [--probe-package <id>]
      Write this directory's nuget.config, then PROVE it with a real package restore.
      why not just dotnet: `dotnet nuget add source` writes a source and cannot tell you
      that the token you just gave it passes the index and fails every download.

  fts new api <Name> [-o <dir>] [--feed <url|folder>] [--no-token] [--skip-feed-check]
                     [--auth <none|jwt>] [--db <none|sqlite|postgres>] [--data-access <ado|dapper|efcore|none>] [--tenancy <fixed|claims>]
                     [--audit <none|sqlite|postgres>] [--events <none|inproc>] [--features <none|configuration|sqlite|postgres>]
                     [--files <none|filesystem|s3|azure-blob|custom>] [--files-local <bool>] [--jobs <none|inline|sqlite|postgres>]
                     [--notifications <none|console|sqlite|postgres>] [--profile <demo|protected>]
                     [--notification-transport <custom|webhook>]
                     [--effects <best-effort|atomic>]
                     [--identity-provider <generic|keycloak|supabase|clerk>] [--auth-infra <auto|external|local>]
                     [--permissions <claims|sql|custom>]
      Supabase currently requires local infrastructure; Docker is never started automatically.
      --files-local (default true) generates a pinned local S3 gateway compose recipe when --files s3;
      set false when pointing at an already-hosted bucket. Ignored unless --files s3.
                     [--cache <none|memory|redis|postgres>] (default none; postgres requires --db postgres)
                     [--infrastructure <custom|single-db>] (default custom; independent of security/effects)
      single-db selects PostgreSQL db/cache/audit/features/jobs/notifications. Generation never starts Docker.
                     [--observability <none|otlp>] [--observability-local <bool>]
      --observability-local (default true) generates a pinned local
